subject: Skylark renewal: capacity uplift & vendor bake-off — defense plan
messages:
From: Amy Chen <amy@skylark.ai>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@skylark.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Upcoming renewal + vendor bake-off / capacity ask

Markus —

Thanks for the quick sync last week. We're coming up on our March 2029 renewal and a couple of things have shifted on our side: our search product is seeing higher qps from peak promotions and we need a ~2.5x capacity uplift for FY29. At the same time, the procurement team has signaled they want a competitive benchmark (they named one vendor) to validate pricing and throughput.

Can Redwood provide a short bake-off plan and firm pricing for the uplift? Timeline ideally in the next 3 weeks so procurement can finish their evaluation before our renewal window. If you have a short MAP (mutual action plan) and a quick benchmark kit, please send it over.

Also attaching the usage curves (summary) for context.

---
Amy Chen
Head of Platform Engineering, Skylark AI
amy@skylark.ai
[attachment: Skylark_usage_summary_q1.csv (csv)]

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Upcoming renewal + vendor bake-off / capacity ask

Fwding Amy's note — Skylark wants a bake-off and a 2.5x capacity uplift request. Procurement timeline is tight (3 weeks).

Ben: can you lead the benchmarking response (bench crits, equivalent instances, test dataset)?
Laura: please prep an updated MAP and escalation play in case pricing becomes a blocker. I want an SLA/latency guarantee for their traffic profile and a fallback plan (compat variant we can spin-up quickly).

Key asks for reply:
- Bench plan + test window (how long to run, what metrics)
- Cost delta for 2.5x capacity (headroom + burst)
- Proposed incentive to avoid a full rebid (short-term uplift credits? extended term?)

I'll loop in Solutions if we need a live demo.

Thanks — Markus
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Amy Chen <amy@skylark.ai>, Raj Patel <raj@skylark.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Apr 2028 11:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Upcoming renewal + vendor bake-off / capacity ask

Markus / Laura —

I've sketched a practical bench plan attached ("Skylark_bench_results_v2.pdf" is a draft report template, actual run TBD). High level: 48-hour head-to-head window, three representative workloads (inference stream, batch embeddings, peak burst replay). We measure p99 latency, tokens/sec, and end-to-end cost per 1M tokens.

We can run the Redwood config that matches their current model family + a quantized variant to show cost/latency tradeoffs. For the uplift pricing, initial ballpark is +45% for 2.5x dedicated capacity on the same family; with a 12-month commit we can reduce that to +25% and include a 10% usage credit for the first month of uplift.

Attachments: MAP_Skylark_v1.xlsx (draft MAP), bench plan PPT excerpt.

I'll need Skylark to whitelist our test IPs and provide a 24-hour test window where their peak traces are replayable. Amy — can procurement give us the replay window and confirm which competitor they plan to run?

-Ben
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood

From: Amy Chen <amy@skylark.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, markus.klein@redwood.com
Cc: Raj Patel <raj@skylark.ai>, Procurement <procurement@skylark.ai>
Date: Wed, 04 Apr 2028 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + vendor bake-off / capacity ask

Thanks Ben — procurement confirmed the competitor is "NimbusML" and they'd like both vendors to run the same 48-hour replay (they will provide traces and expected SLA thresholds). We can do the replay April 18–19; does that work?

Also two asks from procurement:
- They want a one-page term summary (pricing, minimum commitment, termination flexibility) before the bench starts.
- They expect a redlined contract within 5 business days if Redwood's numbers are competitive.

I'll attach the traces (small sample) so you can pre-validate the workload.

-Amy

[attachment: sample_traces_small.json (json)]

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: markus.klein@redwood.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Apr 2028 13:09:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + vendor bake-off / capacity ask

Summary / next steps from legal/pricing POV:

1) One-pager term summary: I'll produce a concise term sheet today (pricing ranges, commit tiers, SLA bullets, renewal opt-in windows).
2) Redlines: we should prepare a standard renewal addendum with the following negotiable levers: ramp schedule, data residency clause (EU customers), and a 60-day termination for convenience for the uplift term. Legal wants to avoid multi-year lock for the uplift unless we provide material discounts.
3) Escalation: if Skylark signals competitive price < our committed price, we escalate to Sales Leadership for an approval on a one-time true-up credit.

I attached a redline template (counter_terms_redline.docx). I recommend we propose the 12-month commit at +25% (as Ben suggested) with a 30% cap on overage for burst (first 90 days). Include a rollback clause to current capacity if traffic doesn't materialize in 120 days.

I'll share the one-pager by EOD for review.

-Laura
Senior Account Manager, Redwood

From: markus.klein@redwood.com
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Amy Chen <amy@skylark.ai>, Raj Patel <raj@skylark.ai>, Procurement <procurement@skylark.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Apr 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + vendor bake-off / capacity ask

All — good progress. Final checklist before April 18 run: 
- Ben: validate bench runners against sample_traces_small.json and confirm IP whitelist + runbook by Apr 12.
- Laura: finalize one-pager & counter_terms_redline.docx items; share with Amy & Raj by Apr 11.
- Me: I'll reserve a Solutions engineer and schedule a joint 30-minute kickoff on Apr 17 (to align metrics and acceptance criteria).

If procurement moves the window earlier, escalate to me immediately. We should be ready to issue a limited-time uplift credit if the competitor's quote threatens renewal.

I'll follow-up after the kickoff with a short internal playbook for discount approvals.

Thanks — Markus
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
